jobs_results.title: Diseñador/a UX/UI
jobs_results.description:
¿ Quienes somos ?

Gstock es una empresa joven que lleva desde 2013 desarrollando una aplicación web para el sector HORECA. Tenemos ganas ilusión y lo más importante miles de restaurantes y hoteles que han oído hablar de nosotros y nos han depositado su confianza. Este 2024 será importante ya que hemos esforzado al máximo para iniciar nuestra expansión a gran escala.

¿ Que buscamos ?

Diseñador/a UX/UI con conocimientos en diseño gráfico.

Necesitamos una persona que sea proactiva con iniciativa y capaz de trabajar de forma independiente.

Experiencia de al menos 1 año creando producto digital.

Imprescindible tener buen nivel de inglés.

¿Qué tendrás que hacer?

Trabajar mano a mano con el equipo de desarrollo el de producto y el de marketing.

Diseñar manejar y componer nuestro Sistema de Diseño.

Desarrollar nuestra imagen de marca.

Crear soluciones de diseño atractivas e intuitivas que aborden las necesidades del negocio y de los usuarios a la vez que sean tecnológicamente... viables.

Verificar que se han implementado correctamente los desarrollos cumpliendo con las reglas establecidas en el Sistema de Diseño.

Realizar trabajo de diseño gráfico offline.

Realizar investigaciones de UX.

Capacidad de trabajar en cada proyecto en todas sus fases desde la investigación pasando por arquitectura de la información diseño prototipado y testeado.

Explicar y defender las decisiones de diseño frente a tu equipo.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Trabajo en remoto 100 .

Mitad de la jornada en horario flexible. La daily stand-up meeting es a las 08 30 y hay que estar conectado hasta las 12 30 el resto del horario te lo organizas tu.

Sueldo según valía el rango es entre 20.000 y 24.000 .

Buen ambiente de trabajo.

Requisitos

Dominio de herramientas de diseño como Figma Sketch y Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator Photoshop etc...)

Portfolio que demuestre un diseño visual e interactivo.

Fuertes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para articular decisiones de diseño.

Fuerte enfoque en la experiencia del cliente y accesibilidad.

Estar actualizado con las últimas tendencias de diseño.

Experiencia en la metodología Atomic Design.

Experiencia en Responsive Design.

Experiencia con Design Tokens.

Experiencia trabajando con Sistemas de Diseño.

Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, UX/UI, UX Research, Design System, Responsive Design

jobs_results.title: Experienced User Experience Designer/Researcher
jobs_results.description:
At Transporeon - A Trimble Company - we embrace transformation and change in total sync with one another. We rethink, reinvent and rework ideas from one moment to the next – as many times as is necessary to get the job done right. That’s how we respond to the new challenges that we face each and every day. And regardless of whether you are just starting your career or are already a pro – we believe you can be the transformation. Are you ready?

You can find more information about Transporeon as an employer here >>

Your transformation challenge...
• Joining our mission to optimize supply chain processes through our innovative products, empowering our customers with transparency, efficiency, and real-time visibility, seamlessly connecting warehouses to trucks on the road. You can read more about your future products here >>
• Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to understand market needs and translate them into usable and valuable solutions.
• Take ownership of the user... experience for assigned web applications, projects, or modules within a cross-functional product team.
• Work collaboratively with various colleagues and internal stakeholders to ensure the best possible customer experience.
• Maintain a relentless focus on usability, ensuring our products meet the highest standards to support our customers' businesses.
• Conduct user research, usability testing, and analysis to continually enhance product usability and effectiveness.
• Champion user-centred design principles throughout the product development process.
• Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in UX design.

You are ready, if you ...
• Bring minimum 3 years proven experience as a UX designer, with a strong portfolio showcasing successful projects and innovative solutions. Experience working in an agile product development environment is preferred.
• Have proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Sketch or Adobe XD and user analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Matomo or Hotjar.
• Possess expertise in user research methodologies, usability testing, and data analysis.
• Demonstrate excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex ideas to diverse stakeholders.
• Have strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset, with a passion for delivering impactful user experiences.

Our Inclusiveness Commitment

We believe in celebrating our differences. That is why our diversity is our strength. To us, that means actively participating in opportunities to be inclusive. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion have guided our current success while also moving our desire to improve. We actively seek to add members to our community who represent our customers and the places we live and work.

We have programs in place to make sure our people are seen, heard, and welcomed and most importantly that they know they belong, no matter who they are or where they are coming from

jobs_results.title: Diseño UX-UI
jobs_results.description:
El equipo de negocio digital de Grupo Mayoral busca incorporar a un/a Diseñador/a UX-UI para el Departamento de E-commerce.

¿A qué reto tecnológico te enfrentarás?
• Realizar estudios de usabilidad web mediante benchmarks, investigación de campo, encuestas, y otras formas de investigación cuantitativa y cualitativa.
• Identificar y resolver problemas de UX, optimizando continuamente la experiencia del usuario para maximizar la satisfacción y la retención.
• Wireframes de baja y alta fidelidad de feautures, home, landings, etc.
• Prototipar el producto desarrollando las diferentes fases de diseño de interacción: arquitectura, navegación, flujos de usuario y diseño de interacción.
• Mantenimiento y actualización de la Librería UI.

¿Qué herramientas utilizarás?

Conocimientos:
• Sólidos de Figma
• Metodología Agile, Lean UX o Design Sprint.
• Herramientas de gestión de proyectos.
• Básicos en CSS / HTML.
• Básicas en Adobe Creative Suite
• Aplicación de normativas de accesibilidad... Capacidad para diseñar interfaces y experiencias de usuario que cumplan con las directrices de accesibilidad web (WCAG) y otros estándares relevantes

¿Con quién trabajarás?
• Dependiendo de la Directora de E-commerce, reportarás directamente a la responsable del área web.
• Formarás parte de un equipo de 30 profesionales dedicados al negocio digital.
• Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos emocionantes y variados, desde diseño de interfaces de usuario hasta creación de materiales de marketing 🚀

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Unirte a nuestro HUB tecnológico ubicado en una zona privilegiada de las oficinas centrales del Grupo.
• Horario flexible de 8 a 17.30h y tarde de viernes libre.
• 22 días laborales de vacaciones al año.
• 1 día de teletrabajo o 2 tardes a elegir a la semana.
• Programas formativos para acompañarte con tu desarrollo.
• Retribución flexible con ventajas fiscales en diferentes productos.
• Atención médica interna.
• Zona equipada para que puedas disfrutar del almuerzo con tus compañer@s. También zona exterior.
• Descuentos en las marcas del Grupo.
• Zona de aparcamiento / parada de bus cerca de la oficina.

¿Qué perfil necesitamos?
• Gran habilidad de organización, presentación y atención al detalle.
• Proactividad y resolución con capacidad para trabajar en entornos de IT rápidos con un enfoque de MVP. Sin miedo a los cambios 😉
• Ganas de aprender, afrontar nuevos retos y sin miedo a los cambios.
• Experiencia con Librerías UI o Sistemas de Diseño.
• Se valorará experiencia en realizar pruebas de usabilidad y actividades de investigación o colaborar con un equipo de investigación de UX.

¿Te gustan los ambientes dinámicos y afrontar retos constantes? ¿quieres formar parte de nuestra revolución digital?

En Grupo Mayoral, sólida empresa compuesta por distintas sociedades dedicadas a la moda, nos comprometemos con la Igualdad de Oportunidades independientemente del sexo, orientación sexual, color de piel, edad, religión o cualquier otra consideración no profesional, garantizando este principio en todos los procesos de selección

jobs_results.title: Frontend developer with UI/UX skills
jobs_results.description:
About us:

We are an AI-Powered Sales Engagement & Lead Intelligence SaaS that helps B2B companies grow. We launched only one year ago and already have 18000+ companies using the tool to grow their business and get more leads. Our company is considered to be one of the fastest-growing bootstrapped startups in Europe.

Why we need you:

As our development team continues to expand, we are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with strong UI/UX skills to focus on frontend tasks. With the increasing complexity of our projects, we need someone who can bring expertise and precision to our frontend development processes.

Responsibilities:
• Convert Figma design files into high-quality React.js code.
• Collaborate with the engineering team to ensure integration of frontend components.
• Participate in UI/UX discussions and provide valuable insights for enhancing user experience.
• Take ownership of frontend tasks and deliver solutions within specified timelines.

Requirements:
•... Proficiency in React.js is required; experience with Next.js is optional but desirable.
• Strong intuition for aesthetically pleasing design
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote team environment.
• Fluent in English for daily conversations and team interactions.
• Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
• Experience working with UI/UX design tools such as Figma or Sketch.

Company perks
• Opportunity to work with a rapidly growing SaaS company in a dynamic industry;
• Chance to work with a talented and passionate team of professionals;
• Competitive salary and benefits package;
• Opportunity for career growth and advancement;
• Casual and dynamic work environment;
• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the success of our platform

jobs_results.title: UX Researcher - Hybrid working model
jobs_results.description:
lastminute.com is the European Travel Tech leader in Dynamic Holiday Packages. It operates a portfolio of well-known brands such as lastminute.com, Volagratis, Rumbo, weg.de, Bravofly, Jetcost and Hotelscan.

Our mission is to lead the travel industry by leveraging technology to simplify, personalise, and enhance our customers’ travel experience. Experts in brightening up online travel, we help our customers find and do "whatever makes them pink".

We continuously invest in talented people who ensure our offering is closer to the needs of the customers and keep us at the cutting edge of technology evolution. More than 1,700 employees spread across our offices worldwide develop our own products and services to power the entire traveller journey for millions of people".

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which... is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

lastminute.com N.V. is a publicly-traded company listed under the ticker symbol LMN on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

Job Description

lastminute.com is looking for a UX Researcher for its Design team based in Spain, Portugal or Poland. You will be part of a diverse Research team and will work closely with Product Managers and designers to conduct research and analyse data to uncover insights and opportunities to improve our product and services. We want someone who is excited about learning more about the world of travel and eager to gain knowledge with the team.

Key Responsibilities

As a UX Researcher at lastminute.com, you will
• Work in a diverse team of UX Researchers with a Lead UX Researcher to guide you.
• Work closely with Product Managers and Product Designers to define the scope of your work and research opportunities from discovery to validation.
• Conduct UX Research activities from qualitative to quantitative, such as (but not limited to) in-depth interviews, usability testing, surveys, concept tests and workshops.
• As part of the UX Research team, you will have an active role in discussing and improving our research practice, processes and activities.
• Be co-responsible for sharing and maintaining our user research and insights repository.
• Empower non-researchers to be involved in UX Research activities, with your guidance and support.
• Build a strong relationship with other areas that deal with user data, such as data science and customer experience to leverage the knowledge we already have of our users and their behaviour.

Qualifications

Essentials
• You have been working as a UX Researcher (or similar role) for at least 3 years.
• You are curious and passionate about investigating human behaviour.
• You thrive when talking to users - but know there is much more to it than just having a good conversation.
• You are a good communicator and know how to present your research findings in an engaging way to different audiences.
• You are capable of working independently and feel comfortable dealing with different stakeholders.

Desirable
• You have experience working within a product team, dealing with Product Designers and Product Managers.
• You are comfortable working with multiple UX research methods, aiming at a mixed-methods approach. You know when to go for each method and when it is best to combine more than one.

Abilities/qualities
• You are fluent in spoken and written English and feel confident doing interviews in English.
• You value diversity and are respectful of cultural differences and backgrounds.
• You are always eager to learn and improve your skills.
• You love to travel and feel that this is the place for you.

Additional Information

About the team

Our company is distributed across major European countries, in a multicultural environment where the Pink spirit gets lived boldly 🦩 through async comms and live remote events, as well as hybrid office gatherings.

Information sharing is crucial and, being a pure digital player, product management is at the heart of our business.

If you think we’re a fit and that we could have fun together, please let us know by applying for the position.

What we offer

By joining our company, you will have the chance to:
• Join a dynamic team in an inclusive-international environment
• Grow thanks to the career journey and our internal mobility perspective
• Manage your own schedule thanks to the flexible start and end of the working day
• Work a shorter working week(36h), of which 4 hours on Friday morning
• Get focus time for learning, development and deep work on Friday mornings
• Work partially or fully remote according to local laws
• Enjoy continuous training thanks to our company platform
• Benefit from employee discounts on travel
• Receive 2 days off per year for the purpose of volunteering
• Get free snacks / fruit / hot drinks / water / beverages at our offices

jobs_results.title: Senior UI/UX Designer
jobs_results.description:
Seedify is a leading Web3 Gaming Incubator and Launchpad for Web3 projects focusing on innovative technologies such as DeFi, AI, Big Data, NFTs, and Web3 Gaming. By staking $SFUND, you gain the advantage of early access to purchase project tokens, enhancing your position within the Web3 landscape. Our industry encompasses Crypto, Gaming, IDOs, and INOs. We operate as a highly-driven and fast-paced startup, we embrace a remote work culture, allowing our team to collaborate from anywhere in the world.

Job Description:

We are looking for a talented UX/UI Designer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating intuitive user interfaces and delightful user experiences for our UGC Dashboards and INO/IDO Launchpads. jobs_results.title: UX Designer
jobs_results.description:
About Us

Always open. Our code, our culture, our opportunities. Leading open innovation without limits. We are SUSE.

SUSE is a global leader in innovative, reliable and secure enterprise open source solutions, including SUSE Linux Enterprise (SLE), Rancher and NeuVector. More than 60% of the Fortune 500 rely on SUSE to power their mission-critical workloads, enabling them to innovate everywhere – from the data center to the cloud, to the edge and beyond. SUSE puts the “open” back in open source, collaborating with partners and communities to give customers the agility to tackle innovation challenges today and the freedom to evolve their strategy and solutions tomorrow.

We are open in our roots and open in our approach, striving to be the most trusted open innovator in the World. Openness extends beyond our technology. Our vibrant community thrives on diversity and connectivity without borders.

UX Designer

Overview

Job Description

At SUSE we’re building open source software that... addresses the operational and security challenges of managing cloud native platforms like Kubernetes, while providing DevOps teams with integrated tools for running containerized workloads. Our Rancher product has over 100 million downloads to-date and is managing mission critical services at Fortune 500 companies and many other organizations large and small around the world.

The Rancher UI/UX engineering team is looking for a UX Designer to help design our web-based Kubernetes management tools. Curiosity and good teamwork are two of the values that drive us as a team. If you are passionate about these values too, you are likely a great fit for us. As a team, we're constantly finding ways to improve ourselves. We pride ourselves on our communication and teamwork – we're all in this together!

Our ideal candidate is passionate about user experience and in designing tools that present complex technologies in easily understandable ways and make performing key tasks an intuitive process.

Come join us if you would like to be part of an innovative, opensource team building rich web-based applications.

Qualifications

Education and Experience: Bachelor or Master's degree in UX Design, HCI, a related field or equivalent experience

Knowledge and Skills

At Least 3 Years’ UX Design Experience
• Experience with Figma or similar
• Proven experience creating user experience artefacts based on user journeys and personas such as mock-ups, wireframes, prototypes, and specifications
• Experience providing UX design for data-rich applications with complex underlying technologies
• Experience working with backend teams, Product Management, and other key stakeholders to understand requirements and limitations in order to provide optimal user experience
• Experience working with customers to understand core use cases and requirements
• Experience and/or interest in Agile methodologies, e.g. using GitHub or other system for tracking work
• Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Bonus Qualifications
• Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker containers
• Experience with open source development
• Experience working with a distributed team.

Job

Engineering

What We Offer

We empower you to be bold, driving your career to create the future you want. We celebrate and reward your achievements. 

SUSE is a dynamic environment that is evolving rapidly, thus requiring agility, strong entrepreneurship and an open mind.

This is a compelling opportunity for the right person to join us as we continue to scale and prosper.  

If you’re a big thinker, obsessed by execution and thrive in a dynamic environment in which you can tangibly create a lasting legacy, then please apply now! 

We give you the freedom to be yourself. You will work in a global community of unique individuals – like you – with different backgrounds, talents, skills and perspectives. A truly open community where everyone is welcome, has a voice and is encouraged to reach their full potential regardless of age, gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristics.  

Sounds like the right fit for you? Click Apply to submit your resume. A recruiter will contact you if your skills match our current or any future positions. In the meantime, stay updated on the latest SUSE news and job vacancies by joining our Talent Community.

SUSE Values
• We are passionate about customers 
• We are respectful and inclusive 
• We are empowered and accountable  
• We are trustworthy and act with integrity 
• We are collaborative 
• We are SUSE!

jobs_results.title: User Experience Assurance Designer
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

User Experience Assurance is a new team at Stripe focused on evaluating and improving user experiences across all of Stripe’s products. This team evaluates, measures, and tracks the experience quality of Stripe’s user journeys. You will work closely with product teams to ensure that Stripe products meet or exceed our high quality bar. In addition, the UXA team works in partnership with product teams to define, maintain, and evolve essential journeys so... that we capture the full set of users, roles, and tasks most important to a successful Stripe experience.

What you’ll do

As a member of the User Experience Assurance team, you will evaluate Stripe’s product and user journeys, identify opportunities for improvement, and partner with teams across Stripe to implement improvements. You will develop a deep understanding of Stripe’s products, users, and business in order to make high impact recommendations for improving product quality.

Responsibilities
• Identify gaps and improvement areas within specific user journeys and across Stripe’s product suite. Act as a force multiplier to assist product teams in optimizing and planning for product experience and quality improvements.
• Implement comprehensive user experience evaluation strategies, ensuring thorough coverage of use cases and driving user journey evaluation and walk the store practices.
• Work closely with product teams to investigate, debug and triage difficult problems and independently work towards results.
• Contribute significantly to improving product quality. Ultimately enable exceptional product experiences and reinforce Stripe's commitment to meticulous craft.
• Collaborate to define and establish user experience assurance standards, methodologies, and processes to be integrated seamlessly into the product development process.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements
• At least 4+ years of experience in a design or user interface-centered role. Potentially working as a product, visual, UI, UX, content, or systems designer. Or you have worked on design and product quality initiatives as a product or program manager. A strong design generalist.
• Strong product and design taste. You have a keen eye for subtle details especially in user interfaces. You can identify the strengths and weaknesses in a user experience and how they measure against a defined quality bar.
• Experience partnering closely with engineers, designers, and product teams to build surprisingly great products.
• Obsession with users, details, and building best-in-class solutions.
• Understanding of how product quality is essential in a B2B product company.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with a talent for precise articulations of user and customer problems. You are adept at communicating technically complicated topics simply and elegantly.

Preferred Qualifications
• Self-starter with the ability to assess, troubleshoot and work autonomously to decompose and solve complex problems.
• Ability to investigate, debug and triage difficult problems and independently work towards results.
• Solid understanding of product development lifecycles, testing methodologies, and QA processes.
• Has experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (typically, 35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

A remote location, in most cases, is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally

jobs_results.title: UX Researcher, Amazon Business, UXR (Research)
jobs_results.description:
This inclusive employer is a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community.

Description

This position will help Amazon Business (AB) realize its enormous potential to help businesses of all sizes flourish.

You'll employ a variety of methods to generate the insights for multiple stakeholders, including product teams, sales, and marketing, to make better decisions for our customers, particularly in the Post-Purchase area.

Key job responsibilities

Amazon Business is looking for a UX Researcher to help reinvent how businesses buy for work. Launched in 2015, Amazon Business aims to make business purchasing easier, faster, and more efficient.

As a UX Researcher based in Madrid, Spain, you'll join a fun, growing global team of user experience experts taking a fresh-eyed look at the complex world of business purchasing, particularly on the post-purchase journey (including AI assistants, Orders, mobile experience, and Customer Service tooling).

Your... focus will cover all aspects of UX research, from learning more about our customers to understand needs and motivations to validating the impact of our designs.

What You'll Do
• Plan and execute a wide variety of research activities with customers, with a focus on qualitative studies. Experience in quantitative methods will be also considered.
• Generate insights from business analytics and customer feedback.
• Collaborate with senior researchers, designers and product managers on research projects to solve problems with data.
• Work across all of Amazon to drive better research practices and bring attention to business customers.

This position is located in MADRID, Spain, and candidates must be proficient in business English to be considered.

A day in the life

The day-to-day for this position will focus on working with a more senior researcher in finding, sizing and prioritizing research opportunities; developing study plans for those research opportunities; executing those studies, and presenting the findings to stakeholders.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:

Madrid, M, ESP

Basic Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in the field of research.
• Master's degree or equivalent.
• Experience in both qualitative and quantitative research methods.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in B2B or B2C e-commerce or financial services.
• Experience with RITE usability method and an understanding of how to impact design and product decisions in a fast-moving and fast-changing development environment.
• Broad knowledge of research methodologies and the proven ability to execute the right methodology to get the needed result.
• A deep understanding of UX research, agile UX, and user-centered design.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates

jobs_results.title: SEO MANAGER (CRO/UXUI) (Apps & Games)
jobs_results.description:
We manage more than 300 Mobile Apps & Games for other companies that are daily discovered by millions of new users and that have been downloaded hundreds of millions of times. We are looking for a SEO Manager (CRO)!

SEO Manager must be able to define and execute optimization strategies for more than 300 apps and video games, in order to achieve the objectives set by management. Likewise, he/she must be in close collaboration with the rest of the areas of the company.

Tareas
• Analysis and Definition of the global CRO strategy to be applied in the company's products to increase organic traffic of all the apps in the store.
• Competitor and market analysis to find organic traffic opportunities for the company.
• Coordination with all departments for common growth and optimization strategies.
• Analysis and definition of A/B testing strategies (icons, screens, descriptions, videos...) to improve the CR of apps and games.
• Tracking and analysis of the main metrics affecting visibility... and conversion for reporting to management for joint decision making.

Requisitos
• Analytical skills and passion for data.
• Advanced level of microsoft excel and powerpoint.
• Self-management and multitasking skills.
• Ability to work under pressure with tight deadlines.
• High communication and teamwork skills.
• Proactivity and willingness to learn.
• Minimum English level B2.
• Any knowledge of a language additional to English would be an asset.

Beneficios
• Stable Project
• indefinite contract
• Full-time
• International projection: We are a global company and your work will have worldwide exposure.
• A significant project: Be part of the creation of a unique project within a sector as vibrant as mobile applications.
• Creative freedom: We let you be the author so that you feel you have an impact on the decision making that influences the results.
• Meaningful relationships: Learn from (and teach) some of the brightest and most skilled people you'll meet. We seek to create a space where talent flourishes and there is mutual support. We hire talent and leave ego at the door. Mutual support and respect are everything - you're unlikely to find a more harmonious group.
• Continuous training: We support continuous learning with training and professional growth support.

We don't offer remote or hybrid work, it is 100% face-to-face (Nuevos Ministerios, 28020, Madrid
